title: TagDuel four-human lobby and Discord acceptance without inventory grants

implementation.behavior: Create a four-human classic-loan lobby using temporary player profiles with empty collections; accept the three invitations through the actual handleTagComponent button route; start a valid 2v2 state; open ephemeral private hands for all four players and expose an action menu only to the active physical representative. Reject a nonparticipant and wrong-guild action before acknowledgement.
implementation.validation: Temporary SQLite, createTagLobby/acceptTag/getTag, tagPublicMessage/tagPrivateMessage, handleTagComponent, validateDiscordPayload, TagDuel integrity and rules profile.

limitations: Discord interaction adapter and builders are exercised offline; no live guild or token.
Player profiles are temporary fixtures; no real player collection or persistent database is changed.
This validates the 2v2 lobby path and does not certify a new card.
